physicalNotes: Radius 0.76 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2989 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract): 528,732 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.77 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2989 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4672 +/- 170 K from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2989 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
